# scripts/ops/Test-AvdUserConnection.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Confirms from Azure telemetry that a user's sign-in reached the landing zone's desktop: the deployment portal's Verify access step (decision 0014, docs/verify-access-spec.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-NamePrefix` | string | yes |  |  |
| `-Environment` | string | yes |  |  |
| `-UserPrincipalName` | string | no |  | Whose connection to look for. Default: you (the signed-in Azure user). |
| `-SinceMinutes` | int | no | `60` | How far back to look for the connection. |
| `-TimeoutMinutes` | int | no | `15` | How long to wait for data to arrive; 0 checks once. |
| `-PollSeconds` | int | no | `60` |  |
| `-Demo` | switch | no |  | Check the demo host pool's desktop (Deploy-AvdDemo.ps1) instead of the landing zone's. |
| `-SubscriptionId` | string | no |  |  |
